status: Declared before examining this experiment's model or curve results
scope: Development assessment; existing validation data, not a fresh final test
selection: Per environment, maximize eight-pick cohort AUC among candidates with paired delta CI lower bound above zero and no measured set's strong-player below-25 rate exceeding incumbent by more than 0.01; minimum 50 observations per set. Otherwise retain incumbent. Break ties toward raw exponent 1, then config key.
assessment: Freeze selected configuration before assessing. Require positive paired AUC delta lower bound and the same tail guard. Failure retains incumbent; no fallback reselection.
simulation: 2,000 eight-pick cohort runs using product difficulty bands, windows, required latest sets and set weights, paired across curves; eight distinct source drafts per run
uncertainty: 200 stratified source-draft bootstrap replicates, 500 runs per replicate; percentile 95% intervals; no bootstrap of simulated runs as independent data
constraints: No outcome statistics blended into the predictor
No production corpus or score writes
Trophy override is excluded from underlying-quality comparisons and remains 100 in production
limits: Cohorts face matched state distributions but different observed packs; this is not observed game-player discrimination
Player identifiers unavailable: draft separation cannot establish unseen-player generalization
Six-set development sample does not represent all supported formats
Daily scheduling is restricted to available sets; not an exact production corpus replay
Earlier validation work makes assessment a development check, not a new untouched holdout
